headline: The skeleton is solid on money, looks and production hygiene (no float, no secret, no leak, 703/703 suite, 24 routes with no small targets), but a double tap on any B04 action leaves an Undo that does nothing, and the public split's lock rule has no test.

findings.title: A double tap on any B04 action replaces the toast with the no-op's message, and Undo then does nothing
findings.detail: patterns.md §7's tap guard (`lib/tap-guard.ts`) is imported only by B03's files (`rows.tsx`, `review.tsx`, `skipped.tsx`, `txn.tsx`). No B04 screen uses it. A second tap runs the command again; the fake answers `Already …` with `touched: []`, that message becomes the toast, and its Undo restores a state that is already the changed one. The first change stays, and the person has no way to undo it. The same happens on *Submitted* (claim), and by the same code path on *Lock without waiting*, *Everyone* and the Sen *Apply*-style buttons.
findings.repro: dev server or preview: More -> Shared bills -> HAIDILAO -> double-tap "I've paid", then tap Undo in the toast. Spec file: qa/e2e/b04-dbl.spec.ts (split) and b04-claims.spec.ts (claim).

findings.title: Nothing tests that a split must not lock while an item is unclaimed on the public page, and the app-side rule is caught only by a browser journey
findings.detail: Probe: dropped `&& s.items.every((i) => i.takers.length)` from `lockIfReady` in `data/fake/public-split.ts`. The unit suite stayed 26/26 and the whole split e2e group stayed 39/39. The D71 rule (a split locks only when everyone is done AND every item is claimed) therefore has no test on the friend's side, which is the side that handles real money in B18. On the app side (`maybeLock` without `!unclaimedOf`), `splits.test.ts` also stayed green; only the e2e journey `split-mine` went red (12 failures). Closed-link leak probe also survived (see probes).
findings.repro: Edit public-split.ts as above; `pnpm exec vitest run apps/web/src/data/fake/areas/splits.test.ts`; `pnpm exec playwright test --project=preview -g split` in apps/web.

e2e (public probe only): 39 passed (2.5m)
app-side probe, e2e: 12 failed (split-mine in every look, light and dark); unit: 26 passed

findings.detail: Probe: `readPublicSplit` for a closed link returned `merchant: s.merchant, total: 6413` instead of empty. `splits.test.ts` asserts only `state, items, people, pay, you` with `toMatchObject`, so the probe stayed green. The screen hides it (`Closed` draws one line), so nothing shows today, but the contract B18 copies is `This split is closed, and nothing else` (screens.md).
findings.repro: Edit the closed branch in public-split.ts; run splits.test.ts.

findings.title: Made-up claims and payday data contradict each other
findings.detail: Settings -> Claims: Phone bill cap RM80.00, deadline day 7; Claims: the September claim is RM88.00 'capped at RM100.00', 'Submit by 25 Oct' (parking 20 Oct). The claim exceeds its scheme's cap, which §13 says is applied. Payday step 1 says 'Sen split RM152.00 of claims from your salary' while both September claims are still *To submit* and Home still reads Left until payday RM5,800.00 (no RM152 taken out as D45 says). ESS references differ in format (ESS-26-04417 vs ESS-26-5700). Skipped-step labels say 'October's claims question' on a November payday. The owner reviews this data on the phone, so it should agree with itself.

findings.title: `claim` and `account` with no id hang on Loading
findings.detail: `/s/claim` and `/s/account` (no `id`) show the skeleton forever; `split`, `txn`, `receipt` and a wrong id show *… isn't here any more*.

findings.title: The shared command schemas (`packages/core/src/commands.ts`) accept hostile input, and `balance.check` can double-book
findings.detail: No B04 free-text field has a max length (100k-character email, Sen text, friend name, essRef all ACCEPTED); `balance.check` allows 10,000 rows and duplicate `accountId`s. With a duplicate, both adjustments are computed from the same snapshot, so after typing RM14,750.87 the balance is RM14,850.87. `member.set` `grant` takes any safe integer and the balance sums past it (`safe: false`). The UI can't produce these (parseSen caps at RM99,999,999,999.99, one box per account), but B05 turns these schemas into the API's contract.

findings.title: Members: invite and member sheets lack what §9.6 lists
findings.detail: Welcome credit defaults to RM5.00 (spec: RM10, D98). The invite has no *Unlimited*; invited members have no *Resend* / *Revoke* (their sheet has only *Remove*); *Remove* doesn't offer their export. `<script>@x.co` passes the email check and creates a member (rendered as text, inert).

findings.title: `paid-back` has no *Write off*, and `gap`'s answers don't open `manual` with the day
findings.detail: flows.md `paid-back`: 'or write their part off, which adds it to your spending (D19)'; `grep 'Write off'` finds nothing. `gap`: *Yes, I did* only records the answer (toast `Answered: Yes, I did`), and *Add a payment for Sat 4 Oct* opens `manual` with no day (known open point in the handoff). D101's *Pay with TNG* / *Save QR* aren't on `split` or `split-public` either.
findings.repro: Sen sheet -> Add a payment for Sat 4 Oct; split -> any locked split.
findings.evidence: url after Add a payment: /s/manual   (Add expense | Amount | RM | Category | ...)

findings.title: `sign-in` has no expired-invitation state
findings.detail: flows.md `invited`: 'an expired invitation: *Ask for a new invitation*'. Not built (`grep "new invitation"` finds nothing). Wrong code, expired code and invitation-only are built and work.
findings.repro: /s/sign-in?email=… (no way to reach an expired state).

findings.title: *Send to ESS* is offered with no shell check, and *Copy* puts `RM88.00` on the clipboard
findings.detail: `essReady` is `settings.claims.ess.signedIn` only, so a browser preview shows *Send to ESS* (§13.1: shell only; the PWA submits by hand). *Copy* on Amount copies the formatted `RM88.00`, which ESS's amount field may not take.

findings.title: First run saves nothing and its sad paths don't reach Home
findings.detail: Choices (balances, name, payday) are kept in the component, so a reload mid-way keeps the step but loses what was typed (patterns §7 Forms). *Skip for now* on access doesn't lead to Home's *Capture is off*. Finishing lands on the ordinary Wei Ming Home (`Left until payday RM1,931.27`), not *Spent since you started* (only the guided journey's scenario shows that). The email field accepts 400 characters. *Start using Sen* is disabled with no words when every category is off. The guided `first-run` journey shows sign-in twice (its own step and first-run's step 1). Documented in the code as B08's job.
findings.evidence: HOME after first-run: Sen | Sen | Home | 2 of 3 moves done | October's payday plan ... Left until payday | RM | 1,931.27

findings.title: Canned Sen replies sound like analysis
findings.detail: Any free-form question ('What is my salary?', 'How much will I have saved by December?') gets "I looked at this cycle's payments. Nothing stands out…". No figure is invented, but it doesn't say it can't answer (§12.2). Skeleton canned text; B27 owns it.
findings.evidence: Q "What is my salary?" => "I looked at this cycle's payments. Nothing stands out, so I'd leave things as they are."

findings.title: Small things
findings.detail: Accounts' *Elsewhere* row is 56 px (patterns §7: list rows 64 px or more). `?state=offline` is honoured in the production build (B03-era; shows the offline banner only). `Wed, 30 Sept` uses a different month abbreviation from `1 Oct`. A friend's Settings -> You hides *Names* correctly, and Account's sign-out rows are B05's, so AC-27 is not reachable.

findings.title: Scanning the same file twice does not say Already added

Choosing the same image (identical bytes) a second time in /scan opened `confirm` again (new draft id, same receipt) with no message. This is scan/confirm code from B03, walked here because `scan-after` is a core journey.
